description: Current and planned disruptions on Swiss public transport (trains, trams, buses, boats) from opentransportdata.swiss service alerts: title, description, cause/effect, validity periods, affected operators/lines/stops. Filter by free text (text: 'Bauarbeiten'), operator (agency id like '11' for SBB, or name), or station (name or UIC number, e.g. 'Olten' or '8500218'). Requires the server env var OPENTRANSPORTDATA_API_KEY (free key); otherwise returns instructions. Example: {station: 'Luzern', lang: 'de'}.

active_only.description: Only disruptions whose validity covers now

operator.description: GTFS agency id (e.g. '11' = SBB) or operator name

name: get_transport_disruptions
title: Current public-transport disruptions (Switzerland)
